page_annotations: The page is otherwise blank ruled paper. Faint reversed show-through from the recto (fol. 240) in the upper half is not text of this page.
Stitching holes appear at the gutter, plus minor specks.
The strip right of the gutter (x≈3185+) belongs to fol. 241 and is excluded: ticks, 'd.', 'e.', 'c.' shelfmarks, 'wrong ko.', 'see s.'.
Image review covered the top, bottom, both margins and the interlinear areas. No other writing was found.
unresolved_relationships: The parent entry of b002 is only probably the fol. 241 d. 266 (5) Vāgbhaṭālaṃkāra entry. This rests on the cross-gutter 'a/. ←—' marks and is not confirmed by text.

coverage.finding: The top-left folio label reads '240' with a superscript 'b' and a dot beneath it, written at an angle in pencil. The candidate's '240b.' and its annotations match the image. Whether the dot is a full stop remains noted as uncertain.

The single ink line at about y≈2650 and its indented second line ('Bhānudatta's Rasamañjarī', at about x≈2220–2830, y≈2720) are both captured. No cancellations or interlinear additions are visible within or around the line. A small stroke under 'preceded' is consistent with the comma after 'Yājñika'. The readings '(lu. 15)', 'S.', 'Scrib' and 'Bhānudatta' rest on cursive forms. The candidate's uncertainty markers are appropriate and are not resolved by the image.

The pencil 'a/.' has a long descending stroke. A leftward arrow at about x≈3045–3135 is followed by a dash crossing the gutter at x≈3185–3275, then faint dots. All of this is level with b002. The disposition is correct as a cross-gutter linking mark.

unresolved.issue: The parent entry is inferred only from the cross-gutter 'a/. ←—' marks. These reach fol. 241's left margin at the d. 266 (5) line, at about the same height of y≈2645. No written reference confirms the link. The target_anchor in r002 and r003 gives the fol. 241 title as 'Vāgbhaṭālaṃkāra'. That form is a normalized spelling. The adjacent overview appears to read something like 'Vāgbhaṭālamkāra', but its exact literal form was not verified at native resolution.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect fol. 241 at native resolution. Confirm the literal title spelling and that the 'a/. ←' there aligns with the d. 266 (5) line rather than d. 130 (9).

unresolved.issue: Several readings are unresolved: '(lu. 15)' could be a lines figure; 'S.' versus 'Ś.' before 1805; 'Scrib' with or without a final 'e'; and the vowel/nasal forms in 'Bhānudatta's'.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with the same hand's abbreviations elsewhere in the catalogue.

review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at x≈3185. Everything to its right belongs to facing fol. 241 and is correctly excluded: the shelfmarks 'd.', 'e.', 'c.', the ticks, 'wrong ko.' and 'see s.'. The b003 arrow spans the gutter. It is recorded here because 'a/.' lies left of the gutter, and the cross-page link is kept as probable only. The upper-half show-through from fol. 240 recto is not text.

region_review.top: Only the pencil folio label '240b.' is present. The faint reversed show-through below it is not text.
region_review.middle: Only b002 carries writing. The stitching holes at the gutter (y≈880, 2500, 3690) and the specks near (580, 2940) and (1780, 3570) are non-text.
region_review.bottom: Ruled lines only. No bottom note or faint addition was found on native tile review.
region_review.left_margin: Blank apart from the paper edge.
region_review.right_margin: Only b003 lies left of the gutter. The facing-page fragment is excluded.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions, cancellations or ditto marks were found. The second line of b002 is a run-over line, not an insertion.
